scope: Read-only public rendered DOM on Mufy and 8091; no credentials or database access

backgroundComparisons.conclusion: Confirmed hue/compositing difference, not proof of lower luminance. A blue overlay is not intrinsically darker than equal-opacity black.

componentComparisons.screenshots: Viewed live but scroll positions and viewport sizes differed; not a pixel-parity comparison

componentComparisons.explicitColors: equal after matching class plus text
componentComparisons.excluded: Hidden source iframe was not inspected. Text-only matching produced false positives due to repeated labels and was discarded.

confirmedCodeMechanisms: OpeningSlot injects sanitized whole-page globalCss into every independent opening iframe; scope is attached to iframe body. This changes root inherited color and text shadow even where the source iframe did not inherit host CSS.

PLATFORM_RESET_STYLE_TAG forces html/body background transparent!important and defaults text to #e2e8f0. Explicit root backgrounds may be erased; current sampled component bodies were already transparent at source, so root background loss is not yet a proven cause for these samples.
ChatStage uses an inline theme-tinted overlay. Ordinary stylesheet background declarations cannot override the inline declaration without important.
Target body has vignette and scanline pseudo-elements. In the measured Duan page chat root z-index is 3, above body pseudo z-index 1/2; their mere existence is not proof they darken chat content.
safeNextVerification: Match visible leaf elements by class/structural identity plus text, not text alone.
Compare same component, viewport, scroll position, expanded state and source asset before attributing brightness differences to theme.
Prove an authored-root-background case before removing transparency reset globally; existing message canvases depend on transparency.
Separate independent source iframe skin from host-page skin, while retaining required source-local variables and authored styles; verify against existing component and reply tests before deployment.
mutations: Only this research checkpoint; no application code, card data, server or database change
